subject.title: Qwen Cloud Token Plan (Personal/Solo) uses a different API than the Team-edition provider, and Linux gating blocks it

question: Should CodexBar support Qwen Cloud Personal/Solo as a documented Alibaba Token Plan variant with its own console gateway and manual-cookie Linux path?
rationale: The reported API is materially different from the existing Team-edition flow and introduces a new authenticated account surface, so maintainers must decide whether it belongs in the provider before implementation chooses its permanent configuration and naming contract.

options.title: Add a distinct Personal variant
options.body: Introduce a separately named Qwen Cloud Personal variant, preserve the Team-edition behavior, and allow Linux only when the user explicitly supplies manual cookies.

options.title: Keep Team-only support
options.body: Leave the current provider scoped to the Team-edition console and document Qwen Cloud Personal/Solo as unsupported until its product fit is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Add a distinct Personal variant
recommendation.body: Introduce a separately named Qwen Cloud Personal variant, preserve the Team-edition behavior, and allow Linux only when the user explicitly supplies manual cookies.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the existing Alibaba Token Plan feature and are the clearest available owner for deciding whether its provider boundary should expand.
